children.text: Bag Upgrade (bags are upgrades, not items)
children.name: Title

children.text: Bags are upgrades now: each one replaces the last, you never go back to a smaller bag.
children.name: Message

children.text:
Inventory v2
  Same 760x610 window as Shop / Auras. Tabs move to an icon rail on the left (48px tiles, art ui/tabs/*). Selected = white tile + coral ring. Hover / long press = dark tooltip with the name. Red dot = new items in that tab.
  Tabs: All, Fish, Rods, Lines, Auras, Baits, Treasure, Materials.
  Rods / Lines: owned items only, coral tick = equipped, "+" cell opens the Shop on that tab.
  Auras: the whole collection; not owned = locked silhouette (still opens the card, no Actions). Footer has ROLL AURA, so the Auras window can be retired: the HUD Auras button opens Inventory on this tab.
  Fish / All: footer keeps SELL ALL; Treasure: OPEN ALL.

Bags -> upgrade
  Bags are not items any more. Capacity pill shows used / max + UPGRADE. Bag Upgrade modal shows the ladder (6 tiers) and the next one; buying replaces the bag. Save: profile.BagTier (number) instead of owned bags; old saves -> highest owned bag.
children.name: Rules

children.text:
ItemDetail.Show(itemId, anchor, opts?)
  itemId  "<Kind>/<Id>" e.g. "Rods/CoralRod", "Auras/SolarFlare", "Fish/BubbleCarp", "Fish/BubbleCarp@Glowing" (stack with mutation)
  anchor  any GuiObject: inventory slot, Character slot, Shop picture, Fishdex card, catch card
  opts    { owner = Player? (default LocalPlayer; another player = view only), side = "auto" | "right" | "left" }
ItemDetail.Hide()  |  ItemDetail.IsOpen(itemId)

Placement
  1. Right of the anchor, 14px gap, top aligned to anchor top - 6.
  2. Not enough room on the right -> left side, nub moves to the card's right edge.
  3. Clamp Y inside the safe area (below Roblox top bar, above bottom HUD); nub follows the anchor centre.
  4. Follows the anchor while the grid scrolls; anchor scrolled out of view -> card closes.

Close: click outside, click the same slot again, Esc / B, window closes, item gone (sold / used up).
Open another slot = card moves (no second card).

Owner check: ItemDetail asks Inventory.Owns(profile, itemId) -> count. 0 = not owned = hide Actions, show Get From.
Actions per kind live in one table (ItemActions[Kind] = { {Id, Label, Style, Cost?, Visible(item, profile), Enabled(...)} }), each button fires a remote (EquipItem, EnhanceItem, SellStack, PutInTank, OpenTreasure, StarUpAura, ToggleLock).
Modifiers: Rods carry Modifiers = {} in the save now (empty), sockets show locked until the system ships.
